correctness.rationale: Conditioning on the observed comparison pattern splits independent underlying variables into L/M/R blocks. The two tested bits reduce to a decreasing endpoint response f(X_{i+1}) and increasing g(X_j); a missing intermediate edge disconnects endpoints conditionally, proving exact independence. If every intervening edge observed, each strict-order kernel 1{x<y} or 1{x>y} is TP2, products with arbitrary positive one-variable densities and consecutive Cauchy-Binet integrations remain TP2. Positive-density strict interlacing produces a positive determinant on a positive-measure set, forcing Cov(f(T),g(U))<0. Adjacent case uses Chebyshev antitonicity. Direct independent uniform-permutation counts checked n=4,5: for n=4 conditioned middle bit covariance -1/36, unconditional 0; n=5 cases negative/zero as predicted. This is all-n proof, not enumeration extrapolation.
residual_risks: Requires common open interval of positive densities and conditioning only on comparison bits, not raw observed values.
